messages.subject: rApache 1.1.14 released
parts:
All,

Just released rApache 1.1.14. Basically it's a bug fix release for
those (mainly me) that are working with rApache in very strange ways.
It boils down to allowing R to invoke the exposed .Call() functions
outside the context of a web request and not have the server seg
fault! If this doesn't mean anything to you, then don't be alarmed.

Binary package for Ubuntu lucid will be available probably in a few
hours but definitely available by tomorrow.

Best,

Jeff
